segments.name: Verification and Certification Segment
segments.description: Third-party verification, certification, product sales and professional consulting services for food and agricultural producers and brands.
segments.evidence: This segment now reports to the same management team under the Verification and Certification Segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay fees for verification audits, certification services, cattle ear tag product sales and professional consulting services.
revenueModel.evidence: Verification and certification service revenues consist of fees charged for verification audits and other verification and certification related services that the Company performs for customers.
